technology_name: A UNIVERSAL MULTI-FUNCTIONAL PLUG-AND-PLAY HEADLAMP SYSTEM FOR AUTOMOBILES
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Retrofitting advanced, adaptive illumination functionality into standard legacy vehicle headlamp chassis requires invasive electrical routing overrides.
description: A modular, plug-and-play auxiliary vehicle headlamp network integrating a discrete multi-functional array composed of a primary sensor, secondary motorized adjusters, an anti-glare auto-dimming module, and a pulsing safety driver panel managed via a master microcontroller.
applications: Adaptive automotive lighting retrofit kits, autonomous night-vision vehicle arrays, long-haul transport safety systems, and smart industrial forklift lighting.
secondary_sector: Digital Technologies, AI & Software, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities, Consumer & Lifestyle Products
